notes.text: Disabling the Receive Mail role disables this operation. The result is the cPanel account's number of email accounts, including zero.
Disabling the Receive Mail role disables this operation. Omitting domain returns all domain-level forwarders for this cPanel account.
The result preserves the documented wire names: dest is the forwarded domain, and forward is the destination domain.
Disabling the Receive Mail role disables this operation. The account's main domain is returned first.
Omitting addWww and includeWildcard excludes www and wildcard addresses. Temporary domains (*.cpanel.site) are excluded unless returnTemporaryDomain is true.
Omitting select omits the select output field. When select is supplied, the documented select output identifies that domain and defaults to integer 1.
Disabling the Receive Mail role disables this operation.

Omitting noValidate runs the email database validation check; true skips it. Omitting skipMain includes the cPanel account's main account; true excludes it. The regex parameter filters results with a Perl Compatible Regular Expression.
